_about: Enemies inside a skirmish: the domains' wildlife and the heroes (decided 9 October, bible section 9; the names are working names until play moves them, the numbers placeholders at the scale of tens, magnitudes and not steps). Enemy damage is static and telegraphed exactly; only the player's rolled faces roll. rank is where they prefer to stand: front foes step up, back foes hold. size 2 is massive and fills both slots of a column; a domain's boss is massive. hero marks one of the party: human-sized, the domain's final, dealt from the domain's bench at the campaign's start; a hero is never in a spawn list. armour (default 0) comes off every blow that lands on the foe, flat, never off a burn. No foe resists a suppress by nature (10 October): Numbed, from a suppress that lands, is the only resistance. aim (default exposed) is the sense the foe's target pick follows, each foe on its own as the round opens: exposed (weighted toward the machine its blows would hurt most), anything, heat (the hottest machine), armed (a machine showing an intact weapon), focus (the rank shares one pick). A move may carry its own aim. on_death {summon, count}: destroyed, the foe splits, that many of the named foe stepping into the pool under its pack (the Gel); a split goes one deep. Player-facing text: codex (what the codex says), flavour (an in-world quote), and each action's text. Every move wears the genre's name where the genre has one (Protect, Cure, Fire, Steal, Self-Destruct) while the engine's words stay ours; the plaque announces a named move when it lands (bible section 5). design is internal and never shown: fantasy (the pitch, the source of the homage), niche (the tactical problem the foe poses), notes. actions is the foe's roster of moves, each kind attack, defend, buff or debuff, with status implemented or planned; only implemented actions appear in the codex. Rank and file have one or two moves, a boss or a hero three, the third a signature that opens on a condition. A move may carry when, one word or a list meaning any (below_half, missing_hull, few_waiting, rerolls_left, machine_hot, machine_armed, back_behind, others_on_field); a move whose condition fails is not rolled, and a special never fires twice running when anything else is open. A defend, buff or debuff names an effect the engine runs (Foe.ACTION_EFFECTS: harden with value, regrow with value; revive_once, summon with foe and count, rally with value; drain_rerolls, burn with value (stacks of Burning on its target), scramble, crack, disable, scorch_all with value (stacks of Scorched on every machine), corrupt_all) and is picked by weight like an attack, in place of a blow that turn. Write {value} in its text for its number. On the map: zone is the pack's ring in hexes (default 1), behaviour push (default; toward the gate) or hunt (one machine, locked at spawn; hunts names the caveat: nearest, weakest, strongest, slowest), movespeed in tens (default 20; foes move binary, water and crags walls; bosses patrol at 10). An implemented attack scales the base attack: factor (default 1.0), strikes (default 1; each a separate blow), swarm (so much more per other foe of its type on the field), keywords (breach: overflows shield into hull; scorch: a stack of Scorched; burn: a stack of Burning; disable and corrupt act on the entry the machine's die shows; self_destruct: the blow spends the striker), weight (default 1; attacks weigh 2 to a special's 1). Write {damage} in an action's text and the resulting number is shown. Foes stand and strike front rank left to right then back rank; the heaviest hitters deploy left.

entries.name: Goblin

design.sprite: a hunched green goblin with a rusty knife, ragged loincloth and leather straps, snarling
variants: a green-skinned goblin shaman in a tattered feathered cloak and a bone necklace, hunched forward mid-incantation, its crooked staff thrust out and its free hand clawed and raised, its small head set low between hunched shoulders

a green-skinned goblin in a dented iron helm and a scavenged mail shirt, crouched low behind a round wooden buckler with a short blade drawn back to stab, its small head set low between hunched shoulders

a green-skinned goblin in a patched leather apron hung with stolen trinkets and keys, lunging forward mid-stride and swinging a lantern out ahead of it, its small head set low between hunched shoulders

a green-skinned goblin chieftain in a crown of bent nails and a cape of stitched hides, rearing back with both arms flung wide and its mouth open in a war cry, the cape flaring, its small head set low between hunched shoulders

a green-skinned goblin in a ragged loincloth and leather straps, leaping forward with a rusty knife raised overhead in both hands and its mouth open in a snarl, its small head set low between hunched shoulders
a green-skinned goblin in a wolf-pelt hood and armour of lashed bones, crouched low and coiled to spring with a jagged cleaver held back, its small head set low between hunched shoulders
a green-skinned goblin in a rusted half-helm and a torn tabard over scavenged chain, charging forward with a broken spear levelled, its small head set low between hunched shoulders
a green-skinned goblin in a cloak of crow feathers, sidestepping low with one hooked knife held back and another thrust forward, its small head set low between hunched shoulders
design.fantasy: The genre's first fight, with a knife. Every JRPG opens on one.
design.niche: There are six of them and four slots. Kill fast or be buried: every one standing makes every other one hit harder.
design.notes: The swarm claw (2 October's ghoul rule): 5, and 5 more for every other goblin on the field. One move, so a disrupt has nothing to switch it to. Aims at anything.

entries.codex: The Meadow's rank and file. Small, loud and never alone: they come in sixes, straight at the nearest thing with a heartbeat, and the more of them stand the harder each one hits.

actions.name: Stab
actions.text: A knife from the crowd for {damage}: more for every other goblin standing.

entries.flavour: They don't run. They don't have to. You'll get tired first.

entries.name: Dire Wolf

design.sprite: a lean grey wolf, hackles up and teeth bared, mid-lunge, on four legs
variants: a lean grey wolf with a ragged black mane down its spine, stalking forward low to the ground on four legs with its head down and its lips peeled back from long fangs
a lean grey wolf with a torn ear and old scars across its muzzle, leaping forward mid-lunge with its forelegs reaching and its jaws wide open
a big grey wolf in a spiked iron collar trailing a broken chain, braced on four legs with its head thrown back mid-howl and its hackles raised
a gaunt grey wolf with a pale chest and a ridge of bristling fur, crouched on four legs and coiled to spring, its head thrust low and its teeth bared in a snarl
design.fantasy: The pack that runs down the straggler, in every forest the genre has.
design.niche: A hunter of the slowest, fast, in threes. Whoever lags is caught, and the pack howls each other on.
design.notes: The Meadow's hunter. Howl is a rally when another stands with it.

entries.codex: Runs in threes and picks the slowest machine on the field. It is faster than anything you own but the cars, and once it has caught something it does not let go until it is dead.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Teeth in the hull for {damage}.

actions.name: Howl
actions.text: Every other foe on the field hits {value} harder next round.

entries.flavour: You hear them before the sensors do.

entries.name: Gel

design.sprite: a heap of translucent bright green slime with a sinister face in it, no arms, no legs, no body, a puddle-shaped blob
variants: a heap of translucent bright green slime rearing up into a curling wave about to crash down, a sinister face pressed into its crest, no arms, no legs, no body

a wide quivering dome of translucent bright green slime with half-dissolved bones and a rusted helm floating inside it, a sinister face of two glowing eyes and a jagged grin in its surface, no arms, no legs, no body
a heap of translucent bright green slime with jagged pale crystal shards jutting from its back, swelling upward with a sinister face, no arms, no legs, no body
a lopsided heap of translucent bright green slime with a darker green core and bubbles rising through it, surging forward low to the ground with its sinister face leading, no arms, no legs, no body
design.fantasy: The genre's first monster, a blob: Dragon Quest's slime and Final Fantasy's flan in one, ours bright green and faintly wrong.
design.niche: Kill it and there are two. Volume is the answer, or leave it for last.
design.notes: on_death splits it into two Half-Gels that step into the pool; a split goes one deep.

entries.codex: A heap of something bright that moves on its own. Hit it and it hits back; kill it and it comes apart into two smaller heaps that step up in its place.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: Flows over the hull for {damage}.

entries.flavour: Count them after, not before.

entries.name: Half-Gel

design.sprite: a small heap of translucent bright green slime with a sinister face, no arms, no legs, a blob half the size of a man
variants: a small heap of translucent bright green slime rearing up into a curling wave, a sinister face pressed into its crest, no arms, no legs, a blob half the size of a man

a small quivering dome of translucent bright green slime with a few half-dissolved bones floating inside it, a sinister face of two glowing eyes and a jagged grin in its surface, no arms, no legs, a blob half the size of a man
a small heap of translucent bright green slime with a few jagged pale crystal shards jutting from its back, swelling upward with a sinister face, no arms, no legs, a blob half the size of a man

a small lopsided heap of translucent bright green slime with a darker green core and bubbles rising through it, surging forward low to the ground with its sinister face leading, no arms, no legs, a blob half the size of a man
design.fantasy: What a Gel leaves.
design.niche: Two weak heaps where there was one. They do not split again.
design.notes: Only ever summoned by a Gel's death; never in a spawn list.

entries.codex: Half of a Gel. Smaller, weaker, and there are two of them.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: Flows over the hull for {damage}.

entries.flavour: Told you.

entries.name: Mandragora

design.sprite: a gnarled root creature with a screaming human face, root legs, leaves sprouting from its head
variants: a gnarled pale root creature with clods of soil still clinging to its root legs, arched back mid-scream with its root arms flung wide and the mouth of its human face stretched open, leaves sprouting from its head
a gnarled dark brown root creature crouched low on splayed root legs, lashing a long whip of root out ahead of it, its screaming human face twisted with fury, leaves sprouting from its head
a gnarled root creature wreathed in trailing ivy with a crown of wilted purple flowers, hunched forward with its long root fingers clawed, its human face screaming

a gnarled root creature with bark like old weathered skin and clusters of blood-red berries among the leaves on its head, lunging forward on its root legs with its root arms thrown back, its human face screaming
design.fantasy: The screaming root, pulled up and furious.
design.niche: Back rank. Its scream costs the team a reroll, which is the Meadow's one attack on the die.
design.notes: The back rank fires as one. Scream only when the team has rerolls to lose.

entries.codex: A root with a face, and it screams. Stands behind the crowd and shrieks the fight out of your dice: a scream costs the team a reroll next round.

actions.name: Root Lash
actions.text: A whip of root for {damage}.

actions.name: Scream
actions.text: Costs the team one reroll next round.

entries.flavour: Earplugs are issued. Earplugs do not help.

entries.name: Treant

design.sprite: a huge ancient walking tree with a furious face in its bark, branch arms like girders, roots for feet
variants: a huge ancient oak walking on its roots, mid-stride and leaning forward with one branch arm like a girder raised high to smash down, a furious face carved deep in its bark, moss hanging from its limbs

a huge ancient walking tree with blackened lightning-split bark and a few dead leaves, hunched forward with both branch arms like girders spread wide, roots tearing up out of the ground around its feet, a furious face in its bark
a huge ancient walking tree in full autumn leaf of red and gold, rearing back with its branch arms like girders raised, its roots lifting from the ground, a furious face roaring out of its trunk

a huge ancient walking tree overgrown with ivy and pale shelf fungus under a canopy of dark green leaves, crouched low with its girder-thick branch arms dragging the ground, roots for feet, a furious face glaring out of its bark

a huge gnarled old tree that has torn itself out of the earth, its whole trunk leaning forward as it creeps on a mass of writhing roots like a spider's legs, its bare twisted branches reaching ahead like grasping fingers, two glowing hollows and a split mouth in its bark, moving only on its roots and reaching only with its branches

a huge crooked dead willow walking on its tangled roots, its trunk bent low and its long trailing branches swinging forward like a curtain of whips, a knot-hole face with pinpoint glowing eyes deep in its bark, moving only on its roots and reaching only with its branches

a huge ancient black oak with a trunk twisted into a spiral, lurching forward as its roots drag clods of earth, sparse withered leaves, its branches hooked into claws above, a gaping hollow in its trunk glowing from within like a mouth, moving only on its roots and reaching only with its branches

a huge pale tree with peeling white bark scarred by dark knots that stare like eyes, its roots lifting it high off the ground as it strides, its thin branches splayed and clawing, moss and grey fungus hanging from it, moving only on its roots and reaching only with its branches
design.fantasy: The tree that walks, every forest's boss.
design.niche: Fills a whole column, armoured, and it regrows. Burst against the regrowth, armour against the storm of limbs below half.
design.notes: Massive boss of the Meadow. Regen when missing 20 or more; Root Storm opens below half: three blows of 10 at anything.

entries.codex: A tree that walks, and it is older than the city. Fills a whole column; nothing behind it can be reached until it falls, and it grows back what you cut. Hurt it badly enough and the roots come up through the ground.

actions.name: Limb
actions.text: A branch the size of a girder, for {damage}.

actions.name: Regen
actions.text: Regrows {value} hull.

actions.name: Root Storm
actions.text: Roots come up everywhere: three blows of {damage} at anything.

entries.flavour: Gate order one still applies. Bring a bigger saw.

entries.name: Needler

design.sprite: a man-sized cactus with arms and legs frozen in a sprinting pose, needles all over, a menacing face
variants: a man-sized green cactus with arms and legs, frozen mid-sprint with one knee raised high and both arms pumping, long needles all over, a menacing face of hollow dark eyes and a thin slit mouth
a man-sized blue-green cactus with arms and legs and a single blood-red flower on its head, frozen in a long leaping stride with one arm thrust forward, needles all over, a menacing face
a man-sized dark green ribbed cactus with arms and legs, frozen low in a sprinter's crouch as if at the start of a race, bristling with needles, a menacing face

a man-sized sun-bleached green cactus with arms and legs, cracked and scarred with broken needles, frozen in a running pose with its body leaning forward and its arms flung back, needles all over, a menacing face

a man-sized green cactus with a ribbed barrel body and stubby arms and legs, frozen stiff in a sprinter's running pose: upright body, legs in a wide stride with one knee lifted, both arms bent sharply at the elbows, one raised high in front and the other swung low behind, rigid as a statue, long needles all over, a face of three dark hollow holes

a burly man-sized dark green cactus with thick ribbed arms and legs, frozen mid-stride in a rigid sprinter's pose: one arm bent up high in front, the other bent down behind, one knee lifted, its body perfectly upright, a menacing face of two dark hollow eyes and a round hollow mouth, needles bristling all over

a man-sized pale green cactus with a single crimson flower on its head, frozen in a stiff running pose with both arms bent at right angles, one up in front and one down behind, its legs split in a long stride, unnaturally still, needles all over, three dark holes for a face

a tall gaunt man-sized cactus, sun-bleached green and scarred, frozen in a sprinter's pose with its elbows bent hard, one fist high in front and one low behind, one leg lifted, a dense halo of long spines, a blank sinister face of dark hollows

a man-sized pale green cactus with a single crimson flower on its head, frozen mid-sprint in an exaggerated running pose: one arm thrust high and far forward, the other swung far back and down, one knee lifted almost to its chest, leaning hard into the stride, bristling with hundreds of long sharp needles, a face of three plain solid black holes

a man-sized pale green cactus with a single crimson flower on its head, long needles fanning out in dense bristling tufts along its arms, back and head, frozen in a deep lunging sprint with both arms bent hard at the elbows, one high in front and one low behind, a face of three plain solid black holes

a man-sized pale green cactus with a single crimson flower on its head, frozen mid-leap in a sprinter's stride with both feet off the ground, its arms bent sharply, one high in front and one low behind, a thick coat of long needles standing straight out all over it, a face of three plain solid black holes

a man-sized pale green cactus with a single crimson flower on its head, its ribbed body studded with rows of long pale needles, frozen in a wide running pose leaning far forward, one arm raised high in front and one swung back behind, its back leg kicked up behind it, a face of three plain solid black holes
design.fantasy: The Cactuar, made sinister: a figure in a running pose that has never been seen to move. Final Fantasy's thousand needles, our fixed ten through anything.
design.niche: Its needles are exactly ten and no shield stops them, and it comes in fives. Hull and tempo, never the shield.
design.notes: Needles breach. Scatter (it leaves the fight after striking, so the pack is never fully dead) waits on a flee effect: planned. Aims at anything.

entries.codex: A cactus the height of a man, in the pose of someone running, and nobody has ever seen one move. Its needles are exactly ten, every time, and a shield does nothing about them.

actions.name: Needles
actions.text: Exactly {damage} needles, through the shield.

actions.name: Scatter
actions.text: It is somewhere else, and will be back.

entries.flavour: Appendix K: do not take your eyes off the cactus.

entries.name: Antlion

design.sprite: a giant sand-coloured insect with huge curved mandibles and six spindly legs, crouched low and half buried in a mound of loose sand
variants: a giant sand-coloured insect with huge curved mandibles, rearing up out of a funnel of loose sand with its front legs raised and its mandibles spread wide, six spindly legs
a giant sand-coloured insect with a bloated striped abdomen and huge curved mandibles, lunging forward low on six spindly legs with sand spraying from its feet
a giant sand-coloured insect with a spiked armoured carapace and huge serrated mandibles, dug half into a mound of loose sand with only its head, front legs and jaws thrust out
a giant pale sand-coloured insect with long bristly legs and a flat armoured head, its huge curved mandibles snapping shut, crouched low on six spindly legs and coiled to spring
design.fantasy: The trap at the bottom of the funnel. Final Fantasy's antlion, Dragon Quest's.
design.niche: A hunter of the slowest that pins what it catches and hardens when hurt. The slow machine wants company.
design.notes: Burrow is flat armour until its next action, below half.

entries.codex: Waits under the sand for whatever is slowest and does not let go. Hurt it and it digs in, and what is dug in is hard to hit.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.text: Jaws close on the hull for {damage}.

actions.name: Burrow
actions.text: Digs in: armour +{value} until its next action.

entries.flavour: The sand moved. Nobody else saw the sand move.

entries.name: Cockatrice

design.sprite: a horse-sized monster with a rooster's head and crimson comb, a cruel hooked beak and glowing eyes, a scaled lizard body, leathery bat wings and a long serpent tail
variants: a cockatrice with a rooster's head and crimson comb above a coiled scaly serpent body, rearing up to strike with its beak open and its wings flared
a cockatrice like a giant scaly rooster on clawed lizard legs, mid-charge with its head low and thrust forward and its serpent tail lashing behind
a gaunt stone-grey cockatrice, half bird and half lizard, crouched low and hissing with its wings half spread like a cloak
a cockatrice with iridescent green and gold plumage, leaping forward with its talons raised, its bat wings spread wide and its serpent tail curled
design.fantasy: The bird that turns you to stone. Final Fantasy's, and every bestiary's.
design.niche: Back rank. Stone switches off the weapon a machine is showing. Show it a shield or a blank.
design.notes: Stone is the old Hush: disable the showing entry through the next turn, when a machine shows an intact weapon; both aim at the armed.

entries.codex: A bird with a lizard's tail that stands behind the others and stares. What it stares at stops working: the weapon your machine is showing is stone until its next turn.

actions.name: Peck
actions.text: A beak like a pick, for {damage}.

actions.name: Stone
actions.text: Turns the weapon one machine's die is showing to stone, through its next turn.

entries.flavour: Don't look at it. No, the other way.

entries.name: Sandworm

design.sprite: a colossal eyeless segmented worm bursting out of the desert sand, its head nothing but a round gaping maw ringed with rows of inward-pointing teeth
variants: a colossal eyeless segmented worm arching up out of the desert sand and curling over to strike down, its head nothing but a round gaping maw ringed with rows of inward-pointing teeth

a colossal eyeless segmented worm with cracked plated segments the colour of sandstone, rising straight up out of the desert sand with sand pouring off it, its head nothing but a round gaping maw ringed with rows of inward-pointing teeth

a colossal eyeless segmented worm with a row of jagged spines down its back, bursting out of the desert sand in a spray of rock and dust, its head nothing but a round gaping maw ringed with rows of inward-pointing teeth thrust forward

a colossal eyeless pale segmented worm with long feeler tendrils around its mouth, rearing up out of the desert sand in a tall curve, its head nothing but a round gaping maw ringed with rows of inward-pointing teeth
design.fantasy: The worm under the desert, the genre's and every desert's. The old Maw's ring of teeth is its mouth.
design.niche: Fills a whole column, swallows through the shield, and digs in when hurt. Suppress the swallow; hull takes it, a shield does not.
design.notes: Massive boss of the Waste. Swallow breaches. Burrow hardens when hurt. Quake opens below half: three blows of 10 at anything.

entries.codex: Most of it is under the sand. The part that is not is a ring of teeth the width of a road, and what it swallows it swallows through the shield. Hurt it and the ground shakes for everyone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: The ring closes for {damage}, through the shield.

actions.name: Burrow
actions.text: Digs in: armour +{value} until its next action.

actions.name: Quake
actions.text: The ground heaves: three blows of {damage} at anything.

entries.flavour: Appendix K, last page: if the sand is moving toward you, it is too late to read this.

entries.name: Revenant

a skeleton in a tattered royal surcoat over corroded mail, a dented crown on its small skull, leaning forward and reaching out with both long bony hands, its fingers spread like claws
a towering corpse-knight in heavy pale grey plate with rags of a banner hanging from its pauldrons, mid-stride with a greatsword swung back over its shoulder, a small helmed head
a headless knight in pale bone-white armour striding forward with a cape streaming behind it, holding its own helmeted skull out at arm's length

a skeleton knight in rusted ornate plate armour, an empty helm and a torn surcoat, lunging forward with a notched sword thrust out, long bony limbs and a small helmed head set low between hunched armoured shoulders

a skeleton in rusted scale mail and a horned helm, hunched forward with a rusted axe raised in one bony hand and a broken shield in the other, long bony limbs and a small skull set low between hunched shoulders

a drowned skeleton knight in corroded green-black plate hung with pond weed and dripping mud, rising out of a crouch with a rusted trident thrust forward, long bony limbs and a small skull set low between hunched armoured shoulders

a skeleton knight in a rotted priest's vestment over rusted mail, mid-stride and swinging a heavy flanged mace back over its shoulder, long bony limbs and a small skull set low between hunched shoulders

a drowned skeleton knight in corroded green-black plate hung with pond weed, gripping a rusted trident in both bony hands across its body, the shaft held level at its waist, long bony limbs and a small skull set low between hunched armoured shoulders

a drowned skeleton knight in corroded green-black plate hung with pond weed, both bony hands on a rusted trident held upright beside it, the butt planted on the ground outside its leg, a small skull set low between hunched armoured shoulders

a drowned skeleton knight in corroded green-black plate dripping mud, lunging forward with a rusted trident thrust ahead in both hands, long bony limbs and a small skull set low between hunched armoured shoulders

a drowned skeleton knight in corroded green-black plate hung with pond weed, rising from a crouch with a rusted trident raised overhead in both hands, long bony limbs and a small skull set low between hunched armoured shoulders
design.fantasy: The dead in rusted ornate plate: a knight's silhouette gone wrong, the helm empty, the plate hanging off the ribs. The genre's zombies and skeletons in one.
design.niche: There are six of them and four slots. Kill fast or be buried: every one standing makes every other one hit harder.
design.notes: The swarm claw since 2 October (the ghoul's, renamed 9 October): 5, and 5 more for every other revenant on the field. One move, so a disrupt has nothing to switch it to. The Ghost is the Marsh's hard to keep down. Aims at anything.

entries.codex: The rank and file of the Marsh. Slow, stupid and never alone: six arrive for every one you put down, and they walk straight at the nearest thing with a heartbeat. The more of them stand, the harder each one hits.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Tears at anything in reach for {damage}: more for every other revenant standing.

entries.flavour: They don't run. They don't have to. You'll get tired first.

entries.name: Ghost

design.sprite: a hooded floating ghost in a tattered robe holding up a lantern with a pale green flame, no feet
variants: a hooded floating ghost in a long tattered grey robe, swooping forward with a lantern of pale green flame swung out ahead of it on a chain, its robe trailing away to wisps where its feet should be
a hooded floating ghost in tattered burial linen wound with rusted chains, holding a lantern of pale green flame high overhead and reaching out with a bare bony hand, no feet
a tall hooded floating ghost in a tattered black mourning robe and a torn veil, hunched forward and holding a lantern of pale green flame low before it, its long sleeves trailing, no feet

a hooded floating ghost in a tattered robe stitched with faded grave runes, rearing back with its arms spread and a lantern of pale green flame blazing in one hand, two glowing eyes in its empty hood, no feet
design.fantasy: A hooded ghost carrying a lantern, the flame the brightest pixel in the domain. The reason the revenants keep coming.
design.niche: It hides behind the wall and keeps the wall standing. Reach it, or chew through.
design.notes: Raise fires only when fewer than two revenants wait, and the back rank fires as one (aim focus).

entries.codex: Keeps to the back rank behind a wall of the dead and keeps the wall standing. Anything that can reach past the front is worth more here than anywhere else.

actions.name: Hex Bolt
actions.text: A bolt of grave-light for {damage}.

actions.name: Raise
actions.text: Calls a revenant up from the pool at the end of the round.

entries.flavour: Kill the one holding the light.

design.fantasy: The genre's death knight: a cape, rusted plate, a sword as long as it is tall.
design.niche: The Marsh's one armoured foe, and it gets back up once. Big single blows, and Suppress or Disrupt on its telegraphed Reraise if you have one.
design.notes: The elite tier's candidate. Reraise is revive_once.

entries.codex: A knight that died in its armour and kept the armour. Hits hard, takes little, and the first time you put it down it gets back up.

actions.name: Cleaver
actions.text: A sword longer than it is tall, for {damage}.

actions.name: Reraise
actions.text: Readies itself once it is hurt: the next time it falls it gets back up, whole, once.

entries.flavour: It saluted. Then it got up again.

entries.name: Bone Dragon

design.sprite: a towering dragon made of bones, a ribcage like a cathedral, skull head, tattered wings
variants: a towering dragon made of bones rearing up on its hind legs with its skull head thrown back to roar, a ribcage like a cathedral, tattered wings spread wide

a towering dragon made of yellowed bones, crouched low on all fours with its long skull head thrust forward and its jaws open, a ribcage like a cathedral, tattered wings half folded, its bony tail lashing
a towering dragon made of blackened bones bound with rusted chains, a ribcage like a cathedral with a pale green glow inside it, its skull head lowered and its tattered wings raised high

a towering dragon made of bones with rags of rotting hide stretched across its wings and flanks, mid-stride with its skull head swung low and its long bone tail sweeping round, a ribcage like a cathedral

a towering dragon made of bones, both tattered bony wings spread wide and matching, one from each shoulder, their long finger bones fanning out with rags of hide between them, a ribcage like a cathedral, a skull head with its jaws open, crouched on all fours
a towering dragon made of yellowed bones rearing up, both tattered wings raised high and matching, one growing from each shoulder blade, a ribcage like a cathedral, its skull head thrown back

a towering dragon made of blackened bones mid-stride, both tattered wings half spread and matching, each a fan of long finger bones from its own shoulder, a ribcage like a cathedral with a pale green glow inside, its skull head swung low

a towering dragon made of bones with rags of rotting hide on both its wings, which spread wide and match, one from each shoulder, a ribcage like a cathedral, its long bone tail sweeping round, skull head lowered
design.fantasy: A cathedral of ribs that walks: the genre's bone dragon, the Colossus of September as it stands.
design.niche: Fills a whole column. Nothing behind it is reachable until it falls, and it does not fall quickly: burst against the regrowth, armour against the storm.
design.notes: Massive boss of the Marsh. Regen when missing 20 or more. Bone Storm opens below half: three blows of 10 at anything.

entries.codex: A cathedral of ribs that walks. Fills a whole column; nothing behind it can be reached until it falls, and it does not fall quickly. Hurt it badly enough and the ribs start to fly.

actions.name: Tail Sweep
actions.text: A rib the size of a girder, for {damage}.

actions.name: Regen
actions.text: Regrows {value} hull.

actions.name: Bone Storm
actions.text: Ribs fly: three blows of {damage} at anything.

entries.flavour: Gate order four still applies. Bring more gun.

entries.name: Bomb

design.sprite: a floating ball of fire with an angry face, no body, no arms, no legs, flames licking off it
variants: a floating ball of fire swollen fit to burst, white-hot cracks splitting its surface, an angry face stretched wide across it, no body, no arms, no legs, flames licking off it

a floating ball of deep red fire with a dark molten crust and an angry face with a jagged grinning mouth, no body, no arms, no legs, surging forward with a trail of smoke and embers streaming behind it
a floating ball of orange fire with long tongues of flame licking off it like a mane, an angry scowling face, no body, no arms, no legs, sparks spitting from it

a floating ball of fire with a white-hot core and a ragged orange corona, an angry face with blank glowing eyes and gritted teeth, no body, no arms, no legs, rushing forward with its flames streaming back
design.fantasy: A floating fireball with a face: Final Fantasy's bomb, the one that swells and bursts.
design.niche: Its death is its blow. Kill it outright or leave it alone; a hurt bomb bursts through the shield and is gone.
design.notes: The elite tier's candidate. Flare Up is the common blow and scorches; Self-Destruct opens below half, breaches and spends it.

entries.codex: A ball of fire with a face, and it comes straight for you. Hurt it and it swells; a swollen bomb bursts through any shield and takes itself with it.

actions.name: Flare Up
actions.text: A lick of fire for {damage}. It scorches.

actions.name: Self-Destruct
actions.text: Bursts for {damage}, through the shield, and is gone.

entries.flavour: If it starts to swell, you have already made the wrong call.

entries.name: Salamander

design.sprite: a long low red lizard crawling on all four legs close to the ground, glowing lava cracks across its scales, flames running along its spine
variants: a long low red lizard crawling on all four legs close to the ground, glowing lava cracks across its scales and flames running along its spine, its head raised and its jaws open to bite
a long low dark red lizard with a crest of jagged black horns and flames running along its spine, rearing its front half up off the ground and hissing, its tail curled behind it
a long low red lizard armoured in plates of cooled black lava with glowing cracks between them, lunging forward close to the ground with its jaws wide and smoke trailing from its nostrils
a long low orange-red lizard with a frill around its neck spread wide like a fan of flame, crouched low on all four legs with glowing lava cracks across its scales, its tail lashing
design.fantasy: The lizard that lives in the fire. Its hide burns what touches it.
design.niche: Front rank, scorching blows, and a hide that burns back. The melee machines pay to hit it.
design.notes: Ember Hide (a foe-side retaliate: whoever strikes it in melee takes a stack of Scorched or Burning, by how threatening it must be) is planned.

entries.codex: A lizard the size of a car that lives in the lava and does not notice. Its bites burn, and so does its hide.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: A burning bite for {damage}. It scorches.

actions.name: Ember Hide
actions.text: Whatever strikes it up close runs hot.

entries.flavour: Do not pet the lizard.

entries.name: Drake

design.sprite: a small winged red dragon breathing fire, on its hind legs, wings half spread
variants: a small winged red dragon on its hind legs, rearing back with its wings spread wide and its neck arched, a gout of fire pouring from its jaws
a small winged red dragon with a crest of swept-back horns, crouched low on all fours with its wings half spread, smoke and embers curling from its open jaws
a small lean winged red dragon with black-tipped wings, hovering mid-wingbeat and breathing a stream of fire down and ahead of it
a small winged red dragon with gold-edged scales, up on its hind legs with its chest swelled and glowing as it draws in breath, wings half spread

a small winged red dragon in flight seen from the side, both leathery bat wings spread wide and matching, each with four long finger bones ending in a sharp point and a hooked claw at the top joint, its hind legs dangling loosely beneath it with the toes drooping down, a straight gout of fire pouring forward from its jaws

a small winged red dragon hovering mid-wingbeat, both bat wings raised high and matching, each with four finger bones and a sharp pointed tip, its hind legs hanging down with the toes drooping, breathing a straight stream of fire ahead of it

a small lean winged red dragon with black-tipped wings in flight, both wings spread level and matching, four finger bones each, its hind legs trailing beneath it with drooping toes, a straight gout of fire from its open jaws

a small winged red dragon with gold-edged scales swooping forward, both bat wings spread wide and matching with a claw at each top joint, its hind legs hanging loosely with the toes drooping down, a straight jet of fire from its jaws
design.fantasy: A small dragon that breathes over the front rank. Artillery with wings.
design.niche: Heat from the back rank: the breath scorches and the stoke finishes it. Lure it onto a cold machine, suppress it, or reach it with indirect fire.
design.notes: The Hellcaster of September, renamed 9 October: Breath is 20 with Scorch so the heat is the rider, and Stoke aims at heat and fires only when a machine carries 20 or more.

entries.codex: Stands at the back and breathes fire over the front rank; the front rank exists so it can. What it hits runs hot, and it knows where the heat is.

actions.name: Breath
actions.text: A gout of fire for {damage}, over the front rank. It scorches.

actions.name: Stoke
actions.text: The hottest machine burns, ×{value}.

entries.flavour: If the sky turns orange, that's not the sunset.

entries.name: Magma Golem

design.sprite: a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through every crack
variants: a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through every crack, lunging forward to throw a huge fist of dripping slag, its small head sunk low between massive shoulders

a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through every crack, rearing back with both arms raised overhead and lava bursting from the cracks in its chest, its small head sunk low between massive shoulders

a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with broken iron shackles on its wrists and molten lava glowing through every crack, hunched forward with its knuckles on the ground, its small head sunk low between massive shoulders

a hulking golem of black volcanic rock crusted with grey ash and jagged obsidian spikes along its back, molten lava glowing through every crack, mid-stride with one fist drawn back, its small head sunk low between massive shoulders

a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through every crack and broken iron shackles on its wrists, hunched forward like a gorilla, its long thick arms hanging down outside its legs with a clear gap between arm and leg, ending in huge blocky stone fists with the knuckles planted on the ground, no face, only two blazing yellow eyes in a small head sunk low between massive shoulders

a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through every crack and broken iron shackles on its wrists, hunched forward like a gorilla, one long thick arm planted on its knuckles beside its legs and the other drawn back in a huge clenched stone fist, both arms clearly apart from its legs, no face, only two blazing yellow eyes in a small head sunk low between massive shoulders

a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through every crack and broken iron shackles on its wrists, hunched forward like a gorilla, its long thick arms held wide of its body, elbows bent, each ending in a huge clenched stone fist just above the ground, no face, only two blazing yellow eyes in a small head sunk low between massive shoulders

a hulking golem of black volcanic rock with molten lava glowing through every crack and broken iron shackles on its wrists, hunched forward like a gorilla, its long thick arms reaching forward in front of its legs, each ending in a huge open stone hand with thick blunt fingers, no face, only two blazing yellow eyes in a small head sunk low between massive shoulders
design.fantasy: The furnace with a body: rock on the outside, lava in the seams. The Pit Lord of September with the hell taken out.
design.niche: The biggest telegraphed hit in the domain, and it breaches, so no shield answers it: suppress it, lure it onto hull that can take it, or disrupt it into Stoke the Forge when another stands.
design.notes: Massive boss of the Peak. Slag Fist breaches. Stoke the Forge rallies when another stands. Eruption opens below half: 10 heat to every machine.

entries.codex: A walking slab of black rock with lava in every crack. The single biggest telegraphed hit on the Peak, every round, until it is dead, and a shield does not stop it. When it is hurt the cracks vent on everyone.

actions.name: Slag Fist
actions.text: A fist of slag for {damage}, through the shield.

actions.name: Stoke the Forge
actions.text: Every other foe on the field hits {value} harder next round.

actions.name: Eruption
actions.text: The cracks vent: every machine scorched, ×{value}.

entries.flavour: They brought fire. We brought bigger fire. It brought the mountain.

entries.name: The Warrior

design.sprite: a lean wiry old man with pale weathered skin and a white moustache, in battered gold-trimmed plate and a faded green cape, the flat of a straight greatsword resting on his shoulder
variants: a broad-shouldered woman in her fifties with deep brown skin and close-cropped grey hair, in ornate gold-trimmed plate and a crimson cape, standing square and still with both hands resting on the pommel of a straight greatsword planted point-down before her
a towering heavy-set young man with light brown skin and a thick black beard, in dented gold-trimmed plate and a blue cape, holding a straight greatsword upright in both hands in a calm guard
a lean wiry old man with pale weathered skin and a white moustache, in battered gold-trimmed plate and a faded green cape, the flat of a straight greatsword resting on his shoulder
a short stocky young woman with olive skin and a long dark braid, in gold-trimmed plate and a white cape, holding a straight greatsword low at her side, her feet planted wide
design.fantasy: The classic party's front: the plain fighter, over-levelled, a sword the size of the tank. Every JRPG's first hero.
design.niche: One big telegraphed blow a round, and below half it swings at everyone. Shield the telegraph, and keep nobody weak when it drops.
design.notes: The Meadow's hero. Cover (it takes the blow aimed at another foe in the fight) is a foe-side interpose: planned. Cleave below half is the three-at-anything form until a blow at every machine exists.

entries.codex: The one in front. A sword longer than your machine is tall, swung once a round and meant, and when it is hurt it stops picking targets.

actions.name: Slash
actions.text: One enormous swing for {damage}.

actions.name: Cover
actions.text: Steps in front of whoever you aimed at.

actions.name: Cleave
actions.text: Swings through everything: three blows of {damage} at anything.

entries.flavour: It looked at the gate like it was a door.

entries.name: The Martial Artist

design.sprite: a tall lanky woman with pale freckled skin and red hair in a topknot, in a green gi with a brown sash and wrapped fists, bare-handed, mid-kick with one leg raised high
variants: a powerfully built woman with dark brown skin and short locs tied back, in a sleeveless orange gi with a black sash and wrapped fists, bare-handed, in a low wide fighting stance

a small slight elderly man with pale skin, a bald head and a long white beard, in a faded blue gi with a white sash and wrapped fists, bare-handed, balanced calmly on one leg with one open palm raised
a heavy-set young man with warm tan skin and a shaved head, in a red gi with a gold sash and wrapped fists, bare-handed, his fists raised in a boxer's guard
a tall lanky woman with pale freckled skin and red hair in a topknot, in a green gi with a brown sash and wrapped fists, bare-handed, mid-kick with one leg raised high

a tall lanky woman with pale freckled skin and red hair in a topknot, in a plain fitted green gi with gold-trimmed pauldrons, a brown sash and wrapped fists, bare-handed, mid-kick with one leg raised high, one fist drawn back at her hip and the other held out in front of her chest
design.fantasy: The bare-handed one: Final Fantasy's monk, Dragon Quest's martial artist, Chrono Trigger's cavewoman with a club. Hits twice and hits back.
design.niche: Two strikes a round, so a shield stops the first and the second reaches the hull, and it breathes its wounds closed. Big single blows beat it; chip damage feeds it.
design.notes: The Meadow's second hero. Counter (a foe-side retaliate) is planned. Chakra is regrow when hurt. Hundred Fists opens below half.

entries.codex: No sword, no armour, and it does not need either. Every strike is two, it breathes its wounds closed between rounds, and when it is hurt it stops counting.

actions.name: Flurry
actions.text: Two blows of {damage}, one after the other.

actions.name: Counter
actions.text: Whatever strikes it up close is struck back.

actions.name: Chakra
actions.text: Breathes {value} hull closed.

actions.name: Hundred Fists
actions.text: Three blows of {damage} at anything, too fast to count.

entries.flavour: It bowed first. That was the warning.

entries.name: The Thief

design.sprite: a wiry young woman with light brown skin and a messy black bob under a dark hood, in a dark tunic and a red scarf, twin daggers drawn, crouched low to spring
variants: a wiry young woman with light brown skin and a messy black bob under a dark hood, in a dark tunic and a red scarf, twin daggers drawn, crouched low to spring
a gaunt middle-aged man with pale skin, a shaved head and a scarred lip, in a hooded grey tunic and a long scarf, twin daggers held reversed, sidestepping
a short stocky woman with deep brown skin and braided hair under a hood, in a dark brown tunic and a green scarf, twin daggers drawn, poised on the balls of her feet
a lean older woman with olive skin and silver hair tied back, in a hooded black tunic and a purple scarf, one dagger raised and one held low, crouched
design.fantasy: The party's quick one: Final Fantasy's thief, Dragon Quest's, Octopath's. Steals, mugs, and gets away.
design.niche: Fast, a hunter of the slowest, and it attacks what you have: a reroll stolen, the entry you are showing corrupted. Below half it flees and comes back next battle, so its final is a tempo check: kill it before it can.
design.notes: The Waste's hero. Flee (it leaves the fight below half and returns next battle, the recurring boss who gets away) waits on a flee effect: planned, and its price must show before the fight.

entries.codex: Faster than anything you own, and it goes for the slowest machine you have. It does not hit hard. It takes things: a reroll here, the weapon you were about to use there. When it is hurt it leaves, and it will be back.

actions.name: Mug
actions.text: A blow for {damage} that corrupts the component the machine is showing.

actions.name: Steal
actions.text: Takes a reroll from the team for next round.

actions.name: Flee
actions.text: Gone, with whatever it took. It will be back.

entries.flavour: Check your pockets. Check the gun.

entries.name: The Lancer

design.sprite: a tall woman with dark brown skin in sharp dragon-themed blue armour and an open-faced horned helm, gripping a long ornate spear in both hands, its straight shaft angled forward and its butt behind her back foot
variants: a tall woman with dark brown skin in sharp dragon-themed blue armour and an open-faced horned helm, gripping a long ornate spear in both hands, its straight shaft angled forward and its butt behind her back foot

a broad young man with light brown skin in sharp dragon-themed crimson armour and an open-faced horned helm, holding a long ornate spear upright in one hand, its straight shaft planted behind his heel
a slim older man with pale skin and a grey goatee in sharp dragon-themed black armour and an open-faced horned helm, gripping a long ornate spear in both hands, crouched to leap
a muscular woman with olive skin and a shaved head in sharp dragon-themed green armour and a horned circlet, holding a long ornate spear level in both hands

a tall woman with dark brown skin in sharp dragon-themed blue armour and an open-faced horned helm, holding a long ornate spear upright in front of her body in both hands, its straight shaft down the middle of her, its butt resting on the ground in front of her boots
design.fantasy: The one who jumps: Final Fantasy's dragoon, Legend of Dragoon's. A spear from a great height.
design.niche: Jump is announced this round and lands next, breaching, so the player has a round to answer the machine it named. Below half it dives for everything it has.
design.notes: The Waste's second hero. Jump (a delayed blow) is planned. Dragon Dive opens below half.

entries.codex: A spear and a long way up. It leaves the ground on one round and comes down on the next, through the shield, on whoever it named. When it is hurt it stops coming down gently.

actions.name: Thrust
actions.text: A spear through the plating for {damage}.

actions.name: Jump
actions.text: Leaves the ground; lands next round for {damage}, through the shield.

actions.name: Dragon Dive
actions.text: Comes down with everything it has: {damage}, through the shield.

entries.flavour: Look up. No, higher.

entries.name: The White Mage

design.sprite: a plump young man with light brown skin and curly black hair, in layered white robes with red and gold trim and a high collar, holding a tall staff topped with a glowing crystal upright in both hands
variants: an elderly woman with deep brown skin and white hair under a hood, in layered white robes with red and gold trim and a high collar, leaning on a tall staff topped with a glowing crystal
a plump young man with light brown skin and curly black hair, in layered white robes with red and gold trim and a high collar, holding a tall staff topped with a glowing crystal upright in both hands

a tall stern middle-aged woman with pale skin and a severe grey bun, in layered white robes with red and gold trim and a high collar, one hand raised in blessing and a tall staff topped with a glowing crystal in the other
a slight young woman with olive skin and short black hair, in layered white robes with red and gold trim and a high collar, clutching a tall staff topped with a glowing crystal close to her chest
design.fantasy: The healer, in the white robe with the red trim, who heals the dead. The lesson every JRPG teaches: kill the healer first.
design.niche: Back rank behind a wall of the dead, keeping it standing: Cure on the hurt, Protect on the front, Reraise on itself. Reach it, and burst beats its regrowth. Holy below half is the one blow it has, and it is big.
design.notes: The Marsh's hero. Cure (regrow an ally) and Protect (harden every foe in the fight) are planned; the engine has both for self only. Reraise is revive_once. Holy opens below half.

entries.codex: It does not fight. It stands behind the dead and keeps them standing: the hurt ones healed, the front ones shielded, itself readied to get up if it falls. Reach it or lose the fight slowly. When it is hurt it has one spell left, and it is a big one.

actions.name: Dia
actions.text: A lance of white light for {damage}.

actions.name: Cure
actions.text: Regrows {value} hull on the most hurt of its own.

actions.name: Protect
actions.text: Armour +{value} on every foe in the fight until its next action.

actions.name: Reraise
actions.text: Readies itself once it is hurt: the next time it falls it gets back up, whole, once.

actions.name: Holy
actions.text: Everything it has, as light: {damage}.

entries.flavour: It healed the thing that was eating the gate. Then it looked at us.

entries.name: The Necromancer

design.sprite: a gaunt old woman with pale ashen skin and long white hair, in a tattered black-and-purple robe, a skull-topped staff in one hand and bright ghostly green fire in the other
variants: a gaunt old woman with pale ashen skin and long white hair, in a tattered black-and-purple robe, a skull-topped staff in one hand and bright ghostly green fire in the other

a heavy-set man with deep brown skin and a braided grey beard, in a black-and-purple robe with a high collar, a skull-topped staff in the crook of his arm and both hands wreathed in bright ghostly green fire
a young woman with warm tan skin and a shaved head, in a hooded black-and-purple robe, holding a skull-topped staff overhead with bright ghostly green fire curling round it

a tall thin middle-aged man with light brown skin and a sharp black beard, in a black-and-purple robe trimmed with bone, leaning on a skull-topped staff with bright ghostly green fire in his open palm
design.fantasy: The raiser: Final Fantasy V's necromancer, the dark mage of every bestiary. The Marsh's other apex, the one that makes the dead rather than mends them.
design.niche: Raise every round, so the wall never thins, and below half it raises two at once. Its blows should cost it hull: planned. Reach it; every round it stands is a revenant more.
design.notes: The Marsh's second hero. Raise fires whenever fewer than two revenants wait, at an attack's weight. Its blows costing it hull waits on a self-damage rider for foes.

entries.codex: Stands at the back and makes more of them. Every round it is alive the wall in front of it is a revenant thicker, and when it is hurt it stops making them one at a time.

actions.name: Drain
actions.text: Pulls something out of the hull for {damage}.

actions.name: Raise
actions.text: Calls a revenant up from the pool at the end of the round, whenever fewer than two wait.

actions.name: Mass Raise
actions.text: Calls two revenants up from the pool at the end of the round.

entries.flavour: Kill the one doing the talking.

entries.name: The Black Mage

design.sprite: a wiry elderly man with olive skin and a long grey beard under a tall crooked hat, in a dark robe embroidered with flame sigils, a staff wreathed in fire raised in his left hand
variants: a short round older woman with deep brown skin and grey curls under a tall crooked hat, in a dark robe embroidered with flame sigils, a staff wreathed in fire held in her left hand

a lanky young man with pale freckled skin and shaggy red hair under a tall crooked hat, in a dark robe embroidered with flame sigils, a staff wreathed in fire in his left hand and a ball of fire in his right
a broad middle-aged woman with light brown skin and a black braid under a tall crooked hat, in a dark robe embroidered with flame sigils, both hands on a staff wreathed in fire held across her body
a wiry elderly man with olive skin and a long grey beard under a tall crooked hat, in a dark robe embroidered with flame sigils, a staff wreathed in fire raised in his left hand
design.fantasy: The one in the hat who throws fire for a living. Every party's damage, and the genre's most recognisable silhouette, redrawn as ours.
design.niche: Fire at the hottest machine, Fira on everyone once someone is hot, Flare through the shield when it is hurt. Cooling and a cold lure; a shield for Flare does nothing.
design.notes: The Peak's hero. Fire aims at heat and scorches; Fira is heat to all when a machine runs hot; Flare opens below half and breaches. Meteor is the promoted form's.

entries.codex: A hat, a robe, and fire. It picks the machine that is already running hot and makes it hotter, and once anyone is hot it burns everyone. When it is hurt it stops throwing fire and starts throwing the mountain.

actions.name: Fire
actions.text: Fire for {damage}, at the hottest machine. It scorches.

actions.name: Fira
actions.text: Every machine scorched, ×{value}.

actions.name: Flare
actions.text: Everything it has, as fire: {damage}, through the shield.

entries.flavour: The hat is not the problem. Stop shooting the hat.

entries.name: The Summoner

design.sprite: a plump middle-aged woman with pale rosy skin and curly auburn hair under a horned headdress, her ears hidden by the headdress, in flowing green robes stitched with runes glowing deep violet, both hands raised with a glowing deep violet rune circle turning in each raised palm
variants: a young woman with dark brown skin and long braids under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing violet robes stitched with glowing runes, both arms raised with a flame in each hand
an elderly man with light brown skin and a long white beard under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing deep blue robes stitched with glowing runes, both hands raised and holding flames

a plump middle-aged woman with pale rosy skin and curly auburn hair under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing green robes stitched with glowing runes, arms spread wide with a flame in each palm

a tall young man with olive skin and a shaved head under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing crimson robes stitched with glowing runes, one arm raised high and the other low, a flame in each hand

a young woman with dark brown skin and long braids under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing violet robes stitched with runes glowing molten orange, both hands raised to call up chunks of black volcanic rock with glowing lava seams that float and rise between the palms

an elderly man with light brown skin and a long white beard under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing deep blue robes stitched with runes glowing molten orange, both hands raised to call up chunks of black volcanic rock with glowing lava seams that float and rise between the palms

a plump middle-aged woman with pale rosy skin and curly auburn hair under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing green robes stitched with runes glowing molten orange, both hands raised to call up chunks of black volcanic rock with glowing lava seams that float and rise between the palms

a tall young man with olive skin and a shaved head under a horned headdress, round human ears, in flowing crimson robes stitched with runes glowing molten orange, both hands raised to call up chunks of black volcanic rock with glowing lava seams that float and rise between the palms

a plump middle-aged woman with pale rosy skin and curly auburn hair under a horned headdress, her ears hidden by the headdress, in flowing green robes stitched with runes glowing deep violet, both hands raised with a glowing deep violet rune circle turning in each raised palm

a broad-shouldered man with deep brown skin and a close-cropped grey beard under a horned headdress, his ears hidden by the headdress, in flowing dark green robes stitched with runes glowing deep violet, both hands raised with a glowing deep violet rune circle turning in each raised palm

a young man with dark brown skin and short locs under a horned headdress, his ears hidden by the headdress, in flowing indigo robes stitched with runes glowing deep violet, one hand raised high and the other low with a glowing deep violet rune circle turning in each raised palm

an elderly man with very dark skin and a long white beard under a horned headdress, his ears hidden by the headdress, in flowing crimson robes stitched with runes glowing deep violet, both hands raised with a glowing deep violet rune circle turning in each raised palm
design.fantasy: The one who calls something bigger: Final Fantasy's summoner, Golden Sun's adepts, the demon summoners of Megami Tensei. The hero-plus-beast pair: the brain behind, the champion of whatever ground it stands on in front; on the Peak that is the Golem, which belongs to the lava field, not to the Summoner. Its own power shows as deep violet rune circles in its palms, never fire (the Black Mage's) and never the rock (the Golem's): Ryan, 13 October.
design.niche: On its own it is a mage with a weak blow. It calls the Magma Golem up into the pool, and the Golem is the fight. Kill the Summoner first and the Golem is dumb; kill the Golem first and the Summoner calls another.
design.notes: The Peak's second hero. Summon Golem fires when fewer than two wait in the pool. Pyroclasm (Hellfire until 13 October, the name freed for the Arsenal) opens below half: a lore change only, the mountain answering its call. The Tamer, planned for the Meadow, calls the rank and file every round; the Summoner calls the one big thing.

entries.codex: A small figure in the back rank, and the ground does what it says. Here that is the mountain: leave it alone and there is a golem in front of it; kill the golem and there is another. Hurt it and the mountain answers for everyone.

actions.name: Ruin
actions.text: A word that cracks plating, for {damage}.

actions.name: Summon
actions.text: Calls a Magma Golem up from the pool at the end of the round.

actions.name: Pyroclasm
actions.text: The mountain answers: every machine scorched, ×{value}.

entries.flavour: It raised one hand. The ground answered.
